name: Ritz Carlton Melbourne
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton, Melbourne: an 80-story luxury hotel in Melbourne's central business district with rooms high above the city, an art collection and a Club Lounge
best_for: Travelers who want a high-floor city base close to Melbourne's cultural attractions
Art lovers who like a hotel with its own art collection

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton, Melbourne was designed by architect Cottee Parker with interiors by BAR Studio.
The hotel is in Melbourne's central business district, close to transport, the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre and the National Gallery of Victoria.
Guest rooms and suites are on floors 65 to 79.
Every room and suite has a feather bed with 400-thread-count linens.
Atria and Cameo are on Level 80 of the hotel.
The spa is on Level 64 and has six treatment rooms, including a dedicated couple's suite.
The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge offers five inclusive food and drink services through the day: breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, hors d'oeuvres and cordials.
Self parking is available at $85.00 per day.

highlights.text: Atria offers a seasonal tasting menu at a 19-metre Chef's Table.
The hotel offers a curated art journey with a private host, from its Indigenous collection to the National Gallery of Victoria.
The hotel has an extensive original art collection.
Ritz Kids can enjoy a storytime with a staff member, choosing a local story to hear.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not give complimentary Club access.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
